title: Driving without a Valid Driving License
text: Driving a motor vehicle without a valid license is a violation of Section 181. Penalty: ₹5,000 fine and/or community service. (MVA 2019)

title: Unauthorized use of vehicle without license
text: Allowing an unauthorized person to drive your vehicle without a license. Penalty: ₹5,000 fine. (MVA 2019)

title: Driving despite disqualification
text: Driving when your license has been suspended or disqualified. Penalty: ₹10,000 fine and/or community service. (MVA 2019)

title: Driving without Valid Insurance
text: Driving a vehicle without a valid insurance policy. Penalty: First offense ₹2,000 fine and/or 3 months prison; Second offense ₹4,000 fine. (MVA 2019)

title: Driving without Registration Certificate (RC)
text: Driving a vehicle that is not registered. Penalty: ₹5,000 for first offense; up to ₹10,000 for subsequent offenses. (MVA 2019)

title: Pollution Under Control (PUC) Violation
text: Driving without a valid PUC certificate. Penalty: ₹10,000 and/or 6 months prison, plus community service. (2025 Revised)

title: Drunken Driving (First Offense)
text: Driving with blood alcohol content exceeding 30mg per 100ml. Penalty: ₹10,000 fine and/or 6 months imprisonment. (MVA 2019)

title: Drunken Driving (Repeat Offense)
text: Second offense of driving under influence within 3 years. Penalty: ₹15,000 fine and/or 2 years imprisonment. (MVA 2019)

title: Dangerous/Rash Driving
text: Driving in a manner dangerous to the public, including jumping stop signs or zigzag driving. Penalty: ₹5,000 (first offense); ₹10,000 (repeat). (MVA 2019)

title: Using Mobile Phone while Driving
text: Using a handheld mobile device while operating a vehicle. Penalty: ₹5,000 fine. (MVA 2019)

title: Riding without Helmet (Rider)
text: Operating a two-wheeler without a protective headgear. Penalty: ₹1,000 fine and 3-month license suspension. (MVA 2019)

title: Riding without Helmet (Pillion)
text: Pillion rider without a protective headgear. Penalty: ₹1,000 fine. (MVA 2019)

title: Not wearing Seat Belt
text: Driving/Passenger not wearing a seat belt in a 4-wheeler. Penalty: ₹1,000 and/or community service. (MVA 2019)

title: Over-speeding (Light Motor Vehicle)
text: Driving LMV above the speed limit. Penalty: ₹1,000 to ₹2,000 fine. (MVA 2019)

title: Over-speeding (Medium/Heavy Vehicle)
text: Driving MPV/HPV above the speed limit. Penalty: ₹2,000 to ₹4,000 fine. (MVA 2019)

title: Racing on Public Roads
text: Engaging in unauthorized speed trials/racing. Penalty: ₹5,000 (first offense); ₹10,000 (repeat). (MVA 2019)

title: Blocking Emergency Vehicles
text: Failing to pull over/give way to an ambulance or fire engine. Penalty: ₹10,000 fine. (MVA 2019)

title: Juvenile Offenses (Guardian Liability)
text: Minor driving causing an offense. Guardian/Owner faces ₹25,000 fine, 3 years prison, and 1-year registration cancellation. Juvenile ineligible for license till age 25.

title: Overloading of Goods
text: Carrying load exceeding permissible weight. Penalty: ₹20,000 plus ₹2,000 for every extra tonne. (MVA 2019)

title: Overloading of Passengers
text: Carrying more passengers than allowed in the vehicle. Penalty: ₹1,000 per extra passenger. (MVA 2019)

title: Triple Riding on Two-Wheeler
text: Carrying more than one pillion rider. Penalty: ₹1,000 fine. (MVA 2019)

title: Jumping Traffic Red Light
text: Failure to stop at a red signal. Penalty: ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 or community service. (Variable by state, e.g., Delhi ₹5k)

title: Disobeying Traffic Signs/Signals
text: Ignoring mandatory road signs or traffic police signals. Penalty: ₹500 (first); ₹1,500 (repeat).

title: General Penalty (Not Specified Elsewhere)
text: The catch-all section for violations not listed specifically. Penalty: ₹500 (first); ₹1,500 (repeat).

title: Disobedience of Authority Orders
text: Refusing to provide documents or information to a traffic officer. Penalty: ₹2,000 fine.

title: Driving Unsafe/Defective Vehicle
text: Driving a vehicle in a condition that endangers others. Penalty: Imprisonment up to 1 year and/or ₹1,00,000 fine (Component-based).

title: Violation of Permit Conditions
text: Using a commercial vehicle without a permit or violating permit terms. Penalty: Up to ₹10,000 fine.

title: Aggregator License Violation
text: Aggregators (Uber/Ola etc.) violating license conditions. Penalty: ₹25,000 to ₹1,00,000 fine.

title: Hit and Run (Accident Reporting)
text: Causing death by rash/negligent driving and reporting it to authority. Penalty: Up to 5 years imprisonment. (BNS 2023)

title: Hit and Run (Absconding)
text: Causing death by rash driving and fleeing without reporting. Penalty: Up to 10 years imprisonment and ₹7 lakh fine. (Active legally, deferred enforcement).

title: Cashless Treatment Protocol
text: Victims are entitled to ₹1.5 lakh free treatment for 7 days if accident reported in 24 hours. (MORTH 2025)

title: Driving against Traffic Flow (Wrong Way)
text: Operating a vehicle on the wrong side of the road. Penalty: ₹5,000 fine as per Dangerous Driving (Sec 184).

title: Zebra Crossing Obstruction
text: Stopping the vehicle on a zebra crossing when pedestrians are waiting. Penalty: ₹500 fine.

title: Lane Cutting / Improper Lane Use
text: Changing lanes without indicator or zig-zagging. Penalty: ₹500 (Road Regulation violation).

title: Using High Beam within City Limits
text: Dazzling oncoming traffic with high-power lights in urban areas. Penalty: ₹500 fine.

title: Honking in Silent Zone
text: Using horn in hospital/school/court silence zones. Penalty: ₹500 fine.

title: Carrying Goods in Passenger Vehicle
text: Transportation of commercial goods in a private LMV. Penalty: ₹500.

title: Animal Transport Obstruction
text: Carrying animals without proper safety or obstructing driver view. Penalty: ₹500.

title: Exceeding Size Limits
text: Vehicle dimensions (width/height) exceeding the limit. Penalty: ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 fine.

title: Sale of Non-Standard Components
text: Selling vehicle parts that do not meet safety standards. Penalty: ₹1,00,000 fine per component.

title: Duty in case of accident (Medical Aid)
text: Failure of driver to take injured to hospital is a violation. Penalty: Imprisonment or fine under Section 187.

title: Dangerous Overtaking
text: Overtaking from the left or in a manner that forces others to swerve. Penalty: ₹5,000 fine.

title: Tinted Glass (Beyond Limits)
text: Visual light transmission less than 70% for front/rear and 50% for sides. Penalty: ₹500 fine.

title: Obstructive Parking
text: Parking in a way that causes danger/obstruction to traffic. Penalty: ₹500 fine + Towing charges.

title: Footpath Driving
text: Operating a two-wheeler on a pedestrian footpath. Penalty: ₹5,000 fine (Dangerous Driving).

title: Riding with Unsafe Pillion
text: Pillion rider carrying heavy objects or children without belt. Penalty: ₹1,000 fine.

title: Driving Mentally/Physically Unfit
text: Driving while suffering from disease or disability that makes it dangerous. Penalty: ₹1,000 (first); ₹2,000 (repeat).

title: Traveling without Ticket (Public Transport)
text: Using buses/trains without a valid ticket. Penalty: ₹500 fine.

title: Punishment for Offenses Relat. to Accidents
text: Section 187 covers failure to stop or report an accident. Penalty: up to 6 months jail or ₹5,000 fine.

title: Carrying Passengers on Footboard
text: Public transport drivers allowing passengers on doors/roof. Penalty: ₹10,000 fine.

title: Not Wearing Seatbelt (Rear Passengers)
text: Rear seat passengers failing to wear seatbelts in a 4-wheeler. Penalty: ₹1,000 (Extended 2022 mandate).
